correctness.rationale: For p>1, convex directional derivatives of F_u(h)=||u+h||^p identify ||u|| via sup over unit directions equal to p||u||^(p-1); local constancy of F_u-F_v implies equal radii and then (S) forces u=v. Applying this coordinatewise gives the arbitrary-index equivalence. Finite uniform preservation follows by a fully stated ultrapower contradiction and commutation with finite p-sums; reverse direction uses the 1-Lipschitz scalar map s->(s^p+t)^(1/p). The endpoint counterexamples have rigorously specified neighborhoods. No computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies a natural permanence operation of Steinhaus (S) for all positive-power direct sums and the finite uniform variant, with sharp failure of universal permanence at p=1 and infinity. It applies to infinite atomic-base mixed-norm spaces with nonstrictly convex L1 summands, which are not covered by the cited atomless-base Bochner theorem. It gives meaningful qualitative context for an explicitly posed quantitative direct-sum modulus problem without claiming to solve that stronger inequality.
